📖 How to use

  1. Choose an image file.

  3. Copy the data URL or download it as a text file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the conversion work?

The file is read with FileReader.readAsDataURL and the resulting data:image/...;base64,... string is shown, ready to paste into CSS, HTML or JSON.

Why is the output bigger than the file?

Base64 inflates size by ~33% — the tool shows both sizes so you can judge whether embedding is worth it.

When should I use a data URL?

data URLs are great for tiny icons and one-off embeds, but large images are better served as separate files for caching.

Is my image uploaded anywhere?

Yes — the file never leaves your device; conversion happens entirely in your browser.
